capacity.title: 3–5 clients at a time.
capacity.body: This work requires presence - not templates, not delegation. A deliberately small number of clients means each person receives the depth, continuity, and privacy that this kind of collaboration requires.

items.title: Understanding where you are
items.description: Before anything changes, we listen. Four weeks of quiet, private observation - sleep, movement, nutrition, bloodwork, daily rhythms - to understand your health on its own terms. In coordination with your existing physicians and preferred clinics.

items.title: A framework built around you
items.description: From your baseline, we shape a structured approach across five dimensions - movement, nutrition, sleep, emotional well-being, and medical data - held between us and built for your life as it is.

items.title: Continuous refinement
items.description: Your framework evolves with you. Through ongoing private conversation, we refine what needs refining - at a pace that respects your time and attention.

about.title: The person behind Aurelis.
about.body:
I'm Vinzent. I work with a small number of clients personally - no delegation. I focus on everyone individually, and if needed, I align with your existing health experts.

Most people who reach out aren't dealing with a crisis. They're managing well, but they're doing it alone - navigating fragmented advice, coordinating between different physicians, making health decisions without anyone who holds the full picture.

That's the role I take on. A brief private conversation is enough to know whether this is right.

items.title: Coordinated testing
items.description: If helpful, we coordinate the tools and testing you prefer - only when it adds clarity. Devices and wearables are selected together - discreet, pragmatic, no effort on your part.

items.title: Physician coordination
items.description: When appropriate, we work alongside your physicians and preferred clinics. We coordinate next steps and ensure clarity between your points of contact.

items.title: Ongoing clarity
items.description: We structure decisions, coordinate next steps, and support you with the continuity this process requires.

hero.title: Five dimensions
hero.body: Longevity is not one discipline - it is five dimensions held in balance. We attend to each individually and as part of an integrated whole.

items.title: Movement
items.description: Strength, cardiovascular health, mobility, and recovery - designed as one integrated framework. We shape your movement practice around your schedule, your history, and your long-term structural well-being. The intention is a body that carries you well - at 40, 60, and beyond.

items.title: Nutrition
items.description: A measured, evidence-informed approach - no ideology, no restriction. We observe biomarkers, energy, and how you feel to find a dietary pattern that genuinely supports your daily life and long-term health.

items.title: Sleep
items.description: Sleep is foundational - to clarity, to resilience, to how everything else holds together. We use available data and your own experience to understand your sleep patterns and gently improve their quality and consistency.

items.title: Emotional Well-being
items.description: Stress, relationships, purpose, and inner resilience are not separate from physical health - they are often what holds it together. We attend to the emotional dimensions of longevity with the same care we bring to everything else.

items.title: Medical Insight
items.description: Working alongside your medical team, we observe the markers that matter. Comprehensive bloodwork, appropriate imaging, and longitudinal tracking provide a quiet, objective view of how your body is responding over time.

cta.title: See how it comes together
cta.body: Each dimension supports the others. The result is a framework that deepens over time.

hero.title: How it works
hero.body: Every engagement follows the same three-phase structure. We observe before we act, build with care, and refine for the long term.

phases.title: Observe
phases.description: We don't change anything yet. For four weeks, we collect baseline data - sleep patterns, movement, nutrition, bloodwork, and how you feel - in coordination with your existing physicians and preferred clinics. This gives us a clear, unhurried picture of where you are before we consider a single adjustment.

phases.title: Build
phases.description: With a solid understanding in place, we introduce changes one layer at a time across five dimensions. Each adjustment is observed and considered. We move deliberately - adding complexity only when the previous layer has settled.

phases.title: Refine
phases.description: Once the foundation is in place, we shift to maintenance and gentle refinement. Regular conversations, periodic re-assessment, and seasonal adjustments keep things moving - at a pace that respects your life.

steps.title: Share what is on your mind
steps.description: A brief inquiry - about where you are, what matters to you, and what kind of support you are looking for. Nothing formal.

steps.title: A private conversation
steps.description: If there is a good fit, we arrange a calm, unhurried call to explore your situation in more depth and answer any questions.

steps.title: A quiet beginning
steps.description: Once we decide to work together, we begin with four weeks of quiet observation. No pressure, no rush.

items.quote: I wasn't looking for a programme. I was looking for someone who could make sense of everything I was already doing - and tell me honestly what mattered. That's exactly what I found.
items.name: Anja S.

items.quote: What struck me most was the patience. No rush to change anything, no immediate protocol. Just careful attention over time. Six months in, I understood my health better than I had in twenty years.
items.name: Lars L.

items.quote: Discreet, precise, and genuinely useful. Vinzent coordinates everything - my physicians, my data, my questions - so I don't have to. That's rare.
items.name: Antonio T.

hero.title: The person behind Aurelis.
hero.subtitle:
I'm Vinzent. I work with a very small number of people - personally, over long periods, with no delegation. I focus on everyone individually, and if needed, I align with your existing health experts.

Most of my clients weren't dealing with a crisis when they reached out. They were managing well by most measures. But they were doing it alone - moving between appointments, receiving fragmented advice, making health decisions without anyone who held the complete picture or stayed involved over time.

That gap is what I work in. My background spans psychology, analytics, and over fifteen years of studying how health holds together across its many dimensions. I've worked closely with people whose lives leave little room for trial and error - individuals who need clarity and continuity, not more information.

I take on very few clients and stay involved over long periods. Each engagement begins with careful, unhurried observation - not intervention. The goal is to understand your patterns before shaping anything, and to remain a steady, discreet presence as your health evolves.

If you're considering reaching out, a brief private conversation is enough to know whether this is right for both of us.

observe.title: Observe before you act
observe.description: Every engagement begins with quiet, careful observation - before anything is changed. First understand, then shape.

discretion.title: Discretion as a principle
discretion.description: Everything we discuss and measure stays between us. No delegation, no tools you need to manage yourself - just a quiet, private overview.

continuity.title: Continuity over episodes
continuity.description: Health changes over years, not weeks. I stay involved over long periods - and adapt to what changes.

steps.title: A private conversation

steps.description: If we decide to work together, we begin with four weeks of quiet observation. No changes, no pressure - just a careful look at where your health stands today.

next.note: I respond to every inquiry within a few days. If I am at capacity, I will let you know honestly and we can revisit when the timing is right.

sections.title: Data Collection
sections.body: We collect personal data only when you voluntarily provide it - for example, when submitting an inquiry through our contact form. This may include your name, email address, and the content of your message.

sections.title: Purpose of Processing
sections.body: The data you submit is used exclusively to process your inquiry and to contact you in connection with your engagement. Your data is not shared with third parties unless expressly required to carry out your request.

sections.title: Contact Form (Tally)
sections.body: We use Tally (tally.so) for our contact and inquiry form. When you fill out the form, your data is transmitted to and processed by Tally. You can find Tally's privacy policy at tally.so/help/privacy-policy.

sections.title: Hosting
sections.body: This website is hosted by Vercel Inc., San Francisco, USA. When you visit the website, technical connection data (including IP address and timestamp) is processed by Vercel. For more information: vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy.

sections.title: Health Data
sections.body: Aurelis does not store or process medical records. Any health-related data discussed during an engagement remains confidential and is not retained in any digital system beyond what is necessary for the advisory. We do not provide binding medical advice.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: This website uses only technically necessary cookies. No tracking or analytics cookies are employed.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.body: Under the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP), you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. To exercise these rights, please contact us at the address listed above.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. The current version is always available on this page.

sections.title: Scope
sections.body: These terms apply to all services provided by Aurelis, operated by Vinzent Zerner, Werdstrasse 127, 8003 Zürich, Switzerland.

sections.title: Services
sections.body: Aurelis provides private health and wellness advisory services. The advisory includes guidance on movement, nutrition, sleep, emotional well-being, and the interpretation of health data - always in coordination with the client's existing physicians and preferred clinics.

sections.title: No Binding Medical Advice
sections.body: The services offered by Aurelis do not constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. All guidance is informational in nature and does not replace professional medical consultation. Clients are responsible for consulting licensed medical professionals for all medical decisions.

sections.title: Confidentiality
sections.body: All information shared during an engagement is treated as strictly confidential. Aurelis does not disclose client information to third parties without explicit consent.

sections.title: Fees & Payment
sections.body: Fees are agreed upon individually before the start of each engagement. Payment terms are communicated in writing prior to commencement.

sections.title: Termination
sections.body: Either party may terminate the engagement with 30 days' written notice. Already rendered services remain payable.

sections.title: Liability
sections.body: Aurelis's liability is limited to cases of intent or gross negligence. Liability for indirect or consequential damages is excluded to the extent permitted by law.

sections.title: Governing Law
